## Checklist

- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] The link works and goes to the official site or repository.
- [ ] The tool is maintained, or it is a well-established resource.
- [ ] The description is a single neutral sentence ending with a period.
- [ ] The entry ends with one license tag (`OSS`, `Free`, `Freemium` or `Proprietary`).
- [ ] The entry is in the right category and in alphabetical order.
- [ ] I searched the list and this is not a duplicate.
- [ ] No affiliate or tracking links.
